references.text: John the Baptist's role as one who prepares the way for the Lord, as prophesied in Isaiah, parallels his actions and words in Luke 3:7.
John the Baptist's call to repentance and warning of coming judgment resembles the message given by the prophet Malachi.
John the Baptist's speech to the crowd and his appeal for repentance and righteous living have parallels in Matthew's description of John.
Philip explains the prophecy from Isaiah to the Ethiopian eunuch, which can be seen as a parallel to John the Baptist's role in preparing the way for Jesus and calling people to repentance.
